briefdescription.para: Runs the QSPI Dual Stack example.
Implements a design example using the QSPI driver (XQspiPs) in Linear QSPI mode, with two serial Flash devices in stacked mode.

detaileddescription.para: One flash is accessed at a time on a common bus by using separate selects. The example writes to the two flash memories in QSPI mode and reads the data back from the flash memories, in Linear QSPI mode. It is recommended to use Manual CS + Auto start for best performance.

The hardware which this example runs on, must have a serial Flash (Numonyx N25Q, Winbond W25Q, Spansion S25FL, ISSI IS25WP) for it to run. The example has been tested with the Numonyx Serial Flash (N25Q128) and IS25WP series flash parts.
